author: Jonas
html:
In a Swedish company with 6000 people, that a colleague of mine worked with, just under 100 had done any personalization whatsoeveron their intranet. That's just over 1 percent - meaning that more than 98 percent didn't do it.

100 persons was, coincidentally, about the number of people employed in the IT department.

author: Justin Lim
html: data after data have always shown that personalization is not worth it. its funny how we keep spending \$\$ on personalization. Like technology convergence, personalization is one of those mythical ideas that we all wish or are convince that work but actually don't.
